ModMetaData.name: SloppyMods Food Waste
ModMetaData.author: SloppyMod
ModMetaData.description:
Food that rots away no longer vanishes without trace. It leaves spoiled food - a stinking, fast-decaying pile scaled to the nutrition you actually lost, not to how many items happened to be in the stack.
Spoiled food has three exits. Refine it into chemfuel at a biofuel refinery, compost it into Vanilla Recycling Expanded's reclaimed biopacks to improve your soil, or seal it into a wastepack for disposal or for the rest of the recycling chain.
Every route is steeply lossy. Letting food rot is still a mistake - this only means the mistake leaves something to clean up instead of nothing at all. Ignore the piles and they rot away by themselves in a few days.
Requires Biotech and Vanilla Recycling Expanded.
